channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: French probe seeks warrants for tech execs over streamer’s death
item.description: French prosecutors have requested arrest warrants for the managers of Australian streaming service Kick over a man’s death during a live broadcast on the platform.

item.title: Americans in Paris to hold 'anti ICE' protest
item.description: Americans in Paris are organising a demo in solidarity with the American people, and against the ICE agency.

item.title: OPINION: PM has steadied France, but sacrificed any hope of cutting the deficit
item.description: Prime minister Sébastien Lecornu has, through compromise and concession got his budget passed. John Lichfield says that Lecornu will likely remain prime minister until spring 2027 - but while he has steadied the ship, he has sacrificed all hope of tackling France's ballooning deficit.

item.title: Sharp rise in Americans moving to France in 2025
item.description: The latest figures from the French government show a 14 percent year-on-year increase in Americans moving to France in 2025.

item.title: French expression of the day: C'est gratuit
item.description: The tone of voice will determine whether you're being offered a freebie or you have upset someone.

item.title: Everything that changes in France in February 2026
item.description: From decreasing electricity and gas prices to the famous French crêpes day and the country's biggest farm show, here is what is on the agenda for February 2026 in France.

item.title: French citizenships fall after new rule blocking retirees
item.description: A new rule on French income that effectively excludes foreign retirees from ever becoming French has led to a significant fall in the number of people being naturalised, according to the Interior Ministry.

item.title: Latest: How is France’s high-speed internet rollout going?
item.description: The rollout of high-speed fibre internet across France enters a new phase this year as more of the old copper ADSL connections will be switched off - so how well served are French towns and cities when it comes to internet speeds?

item.title: What to do and where to go in France in Spring 2026
item.description: It’s cold and a bit dank outside right now, but Spring really isn’t that far away, so here’s what’s coming up in France as the days get longer, the sky bluer, and the sun warmer.

item.title: Train tickets go on sale for France's May 2026 holiday weekends
item.description: French rail operator SNCF has opened ticket sales for the Easter holidays and the long 'pont' weekends in May.
